# Getting Started
Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/getting-started

Claude Code is a command-line tool for agentic coding.
It lets you delegate complex tasks to Claude directly from your terminal.

# Agents
Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agents

Agents allow Claude Code to work autonomously on multi-step tasks.
Configure them in your project's settings.

# Hooks
Source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks

Hooks let you run custom commands at specific points in Claude Code's lifecycle.
Use PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks to intercept tool calls.
